reply.text: {"say":"Two upper-body days, built around pushing and pulling strength with no direct leg work, since your running covers the legs. Each day leads with a heavier compound and finishes with light accessories.","title":"Upper Body Strength","days":[{"name":"Upper A","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":4,"repsTo":6,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Controlled descent, pause lightly on the chest."},{"key":"inverted-row","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the body in one straight line."},{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace the trunk, press without arching."},{"key":"cable-lat-pulldown","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull to the upper chest, squeeze the lats."},{"key":"cable-triceps-pushdown","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows pinned to the sides."},{"key":"dumbbell-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the lowering phase."}]},{"name":"Upper B","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-overhead-press","sets":4,"reps":4,"repsTo":6,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Tight core, bar path straight over the midfoot."},{"key":"barbell-bent-over-row","sets":4,"reps":4,"repsTo":6,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Flat back, pull the bar to the lower ribs."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Bench set at a moderate incline."},{"key":"chest-supported-row-machine","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Drive the elbows back, pause at the top."},{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep the elbows close to the head."},{"key":"cable-face-pull","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pull toward the forehead, elbows high."}]}],"unmet":[]}
